name: timestamp
label: Timestamp
help: Map the Make scenario log timestamp.

name: imtId
label: Make Log Event ID
help: Map imtId from the Make scenario log bundle.

name: eventType
label: Make Event Type
help: Map eventType from the Make scenario log bundle.

name: statusLabel
label: Status Label
help: Map statusLabel from the Make scenario log bundle, for example Success.

name: status
label: Status
help: Map status from the Make scenario log bundle.

name: scenarioName
label: Scenario Name
help: Map scenarioName from the Make scenario log bundle.

name: scenarioId
label: Scenario ID
help: Map scenarioId from the Make scenario log bundle.

name: customPropertiesToSend
label: Custom Properties to Send
help: Optional. Select Make scenario custom properties to include in the Observe payload. If nothing is selected, no custom properties are sent.

name: executionId
label: Execution ID
help: Map id from the Make scenario log bundle.

name: executionType
label: Execution Type
help: Map type from the Make scenario log bundle, for example manual.

name: duration
label: Duration (Milliseconds)
help: Map duration from the Make scenario log bundle.

name: centicredits
label: Centicredits
help: Map centicredits from the Make scenario log bundle. Credits Consumed is calculated as centicredits divided by 100.

name: operations
label: Operations
help: Map operations from the Make scenario log bundle.

name: transfer
label: Data Transfer (Bytes)
help: Map transfer from the Make scenario log bundle.

name: details
label: Details
help: Optional extra structured data to include in the Observe event.
